notes: The apodosis waw of `וְחָפַרְתָּה` is `unrepresented`: the ASV writes no connective before *thou shalt dig* (rule 14).
`בָהּ` → *therewith* is one fused unit headed on the preposition, since no relative stands (rules 22, 30).
`צֵאָתֶךָ` is recast as *that which cometh from thee*: the noun takes the supplied antecedent and relative (rule 46) and the suffix takes *from thee* (rule 18).
